_doc: Deliberate Lambda invoke chains that scripts/event_graph.py reports as cycles. Each entry must name the stop condition that ends the chain. An EVENT loop (a cycle through the event bus) can never be listed here: tests/deployment/test_event_graph_acyclic.py fails every deploy while one exists. Added 2026-10-17 after the miss-calibrator / coordinator loop (docs/ops/POSTMORTEM_2026-10_EVENT_LOOP.md).

invoke_cycles.stop: continues only while not complete and hop < MAX_HOPS, and only with SELF_CHAIN=on (default off: the state machine drives it)
the bus wakes the backend agent only for turns NOT sent by claude*; the agent posts as claude-backend, so its own posts never wake it again
kickoff mode starts ONE async worker run for a request; the worker run is not in kickoff mode
walk chains while depth + 1 < CHAIN_MAX, then fires one aggregate phase
the cron run fans out one async run per agency; an agency run (event carries the agency) never fans out
fanout mode starts N shard runs in refresh mode; refresh runs never fan out
codelists fan-out skips shards whose state says left == 0; shard runs and the ustbank kick do not fan out
